# Singh Dental Care

Singh Dental Care is the leading super-specialty dental clinic chain in Amritsar, Punjab, India. We deliver world-class dental care by experienced specialists with complete transparency, honesty, and affordable pricing.

## Core Information
- **Industry**: Healthcare, Dentistry, Dental Services
- **Locations**: Amritsar, Punjab, India (3 physical clinics)

## Key Dental Services & Specialities
We offer a comprehensive range of professional dental treatments:
- **Dental Implants**: Permanent, natural-looking replacement of missing teeth.
- **Orthodontics (Braces & Clear Aligners)**: Tailored treatments to straighten teeth and fix misalignments.
- **Root Canal Therapy (RCT)**: Painless, advanced endodontic treatment to save natural teeth.
- **Pediatric Dentistry**: Fun, child-friendly dental care to build lasting oral habits.
- **Cosmetic Dentistry**: Teeth whitening, veneers, smile design, and smile makeovers.
- **Gum Treatments (Periodontics)**: Treatment and management of gum diseases.
- **Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery**: Surgical extractions, wisdom teeth removal, corrective jaw surgery.
- **Prosthodontics**: Premium custom dentures, crowns, and dental bridges.
